scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w bot-core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w tools
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w bot-core && vitest run
scripts.test:watch: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w bot-core && vitest
scripts.bot:run: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w bot-core && npm run build -w tools && npm run bot:run -w tools
scripts.bot:evaluate: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w bot-core && npm run build -w server && npm run bot:evaluate -w server
